reviews.comment: Professor Deer was an amazing professor. She was the perfect person to introduce a group of freshman into Mays. She took the time to learn all of the students names and my class was over 200 people. She allowed a way for us students to really decided what we want to do for our careers.

She is super caring and she personally reached out when I was going some things. Don't skip the classes or you could miss hard to catch up on test questions. It's not a hard class if you attend. It has a few case assignments that are heavily weighted so if you mess them up, there is no recovering your grade. My biggest advice is read the rubrics!

If you have the opportunity to take Dr. Deer for your BUSN 101 class, you will not be disappointed! Dr. Deer truly cares about her students and puts great effort into her lectures to help you understand the content. She is passionate about what she teaches and has amazing real-world experience to provide a unique learning environment.
Dr. Deer is literally the best. She gets to know her students on a personal level and is an effective communicator. Her lectures are very engaging and her grading rubrics are very clear.
